evidence.detail: General link style applies font-family: var(--heading-font-family) and text-transform: lowercase, producing small-caps for Latin glyphs
.language-switcher and .language-menu use standard link styling, so Cyrillic/CJK fall back to symbol fonts which lack the small-caps treatment
Author explicitly states 'I tried switching to our base font but honestly it wasn't much better so not sure what's ideal here'

triage.notes: The author has already investigated the straightforward font fix and found it unsatisfying. Deciding the ideal treatment (override font for language menu, use a dedicated multilingual font, change the switcher to icons, etc.) requires a product/design call.
